name: Pancakes
instructions: Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and whisk until just combined.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle, using approximately 1/4 cup for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges are dry, then flip and cook until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite toppings.

name: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Whisk together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are cooked to your liking.
